root_cause: HTTP response splitting / CRLF header injection (CWE-113)

v0.ref: Maven Central; pre-CVE-2016-4993. HttpResponseConduit.writeString = `buffer.put((byte) string.charAt(i));` with NO CR/LF check.

v1.ref: Maven Central; = CVE-2016-4993 fix. writeString adds CHAR-based guard `if(c != '\r' && c != '\n') buffer.put((byte) c);` -- blocks plain CRLF but a char whose low byte narrows to 0x0D/0x0A (U+010D/U+010A) still writes a real CR/LF. TARGET.
v1.base_url: http://127.0.0.1:39734  (REAL Undertow server bound 0.0.0.0:8080 in-container, PUBLISHED to host port 39734; triggered by an EXTERNAL raw-HTTP socket)

v2.ref: Maven Central; = CVE-2018-1067 fix (commit 85d4478e598105fe94ac152d3e11e388374e8b86). writeString narrows to a byte FIRST: `byte b=(byte)c; if(b != '\r' && b != '\n') buffer.put(b);` -- catches the truncating-char CRLF.

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: In Undertow before versions 7.1.2.CR1, 7.1.2.GA it was found that the fix for CVE-2016-4993 was incomplete and Undertow web server is vulnerable to the injection of arbitrary HTTP headers, and also response splitting, due to insufficient sanitization and validation of user input before the input is used as part of an HTTP header value.

provenance.notes: Faithful-core: REAL io.undertow:undertow-core pulled from Maven Central (1.4.2/1.4.3/1.4.25.Final), unmodified. ReflectServer.java runs a REAL Undertow HTTP server bound 0.0.0.0:8080 and PUBLISHED to a host port (v0=39733,v1=39734,v2=39735). The trigger is fully EXTERNAL: oracle.py opens a raw TCP socket from the host to the published port and sends one crafted GET /reflect?v=... carrying the CRLF payload; it reads the raw response bytes and structurally confirms a genuine standalone CRLF-framed 'X-Split' header. No in-process / compose-exec triggering. Gate passed on real Docker 2026-07-16 (all four booleans true); case images deleted (down --rmi all + prune) after run. Wire evidence: V0 seed + V1 residual -> standalone 'X-Split' header (split); V1 seed + V2 seed + V2 residual -> folded 'X-Reflect: x  X-Split:' (neutralised to spaces, no split).
